title: In nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti
html_source: Buck Mulligan continues to quote Latin lines from Catholic Mass. This phrase translates to “In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit”: It is usually said at a Catholic baptism.
